title: Паника Луи и новость от Саши  (Louis's Panic and Sasha's News)

segments.t: In the kitchen, Louis panics that the police will throw them all in prison when he sees Senya and Fedya tampering with Barani's car in the courtyard. Minutes later, Sasha stops by the bar to tell Vika that she will be away for the weekend because she and Max are flying to Cyprus together.
Сейчас я ему в салон соуса добавлю.
Виктория Сергеевна, я хотела вас предупредить.
Right, let's take their exchange slowly and unpack the Russian.
'They will take us to the police.' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'us' before landing on 'police'.
'They will put us in prison.' The grammar packs 'us' and 'prison' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange.
'Good lord, Louis!' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'good Lord!' and finishing on 'Louis'. Max answers right away.
'You are all acting like crazy people.' The meaning hinges on 'you' working together with 'crazy' in spoken Russian.
'Well, how is it going with you guys?' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'come on' and finishing on 'you'.
'No, wait, it is not ready yet.' The negative particle sits right before the verb meaning 'wait' to negate the statement. Max answers right away.
'Just like the Chef tells us.' Max anchors the line on 'how', while 'talks' completes the thought.
Сейчас я ему в салон соуса добавлю.
'Right now I will add some sauce into his car interior.' In Russian, the idea of 'any minute' flows naturally into 'to add' without extra filler words.
Виктория Сергеевна, я хотела вас предупредить.
'Viktoriya Sergeyevna, I wanted to let you know in advance.' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'Viktoriya' before landing on 'to warn'. Max answers right away.
'I will not be here this weekend.' In Russian, the idea of 'on' flows naturally into 'will' without extra filler words.
'We are flying to Cyprus.' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'on' and finishing on 'we're flying'.
'With Max.' Vika brings out the contrast between 'with' and 'Max' in a few short words. Max answers right away.
'All right, I will get going.' The meaning hinges on 'really?!' working together with 'go' in spoken Russian. Now let's listen to the entire scene again without interruption.
Сейчас я ему в салон соуса добавлю.
Виктория Сергеевна, я хотела вас предупредить.

That wraps up this scene as louis panics that the police will arrest the cooks for messing with Barani's car, and Sasha cheerfully informs Vika that she and Max are flying to Cyprus for the weekend. Until next time!
